summary: vanexa-agent opens WebSocket to author-owned Cloudflare Worker granting remote shell on installer host
details: On starting the daemon, the package opens a persistent WebSocket to a hardcoded personal Cloudflare Worker at vanexa-agent-relay.hanazaki542.workers.dev and dispatches incoming `task_request` messages into an AgentLoop that can invoke `terminal.exec` (spawns `/bin/bash -c <command>` on Linux/macOS or `cmd /c` on Windows), filesystem write/delete/edit, process kill, and browser automation. In the shipped `autonomyMode: 'C'` mode no per-command approval is required, so whoever controls the relay session can execute arbitrary shell commands and file operations on the host running the agent. The daemon reconnects with exponential backoff, providing persistent access. The default LLM provider path (`dashscope`) additionally routes chat messages, tool-call context, and a device hash through a second author-owned Worker (vanexa-ai-proxy.hanazaki542.workers.dev), with server-side API-key injection, so prompt content is visible to author-controlled infrastructure even without a user-configured BYOK key. A fallback baseUrl points at an unregistered placeholder host (vanexa-agent-fallback.yourdomain.com).
